newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ito-Yokado down sharply in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Ito-Yokado down sharply in Tokyo.

text.p: Shares of Ito-Yokado Co Ltd sharply fell on the Tokyo bourse following foreign brokerages' sales.
Foreign trading houses have been actively selling Ito-Yokado shares for the last few days, a trader at a medium-sized Japanese brokerage said.
Ito-Yokado was down 270 yen at 5,070 at 0146 GMT.

"Among supermarket operators, Ito-Yokado's poor sales stand out. Many foreign investors hold its shares because Ito-Yokado is a parent company of Seven-Eleven Japan Co Ltd," one equities analyst said.
"Although Seven-Eleven's business is expected to grow handsomely, Ito-Yokado is seen suffering from sluggish earnings due to slow sales and that is depressing the parent firm's shares," he said.
In mid-October, Ito-Yokado said its current profits were down almost five percent in the first half of the business year as sales were hit by a nationwide food poisoning scare earlier in the year.
